subject: Consolidating APAC-friendly UTC slices for NodeWave co-sell demo
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@nodewave.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: NodeWave Partnerships <partners@nodewave.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — APAC co-sell demo (compact window request)

Hi Irene / Karthik,

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host a joint Redwood x NodeWave marketplace demo for some APAC prospects next week. We have a tight set of customers in APAC (Singapore + Sydney) and they prefer a single compact timebox that still lands within workable local hours.

Would Redwood be able to consolidate the rehearsal + customer demo into a single 90-minute UTC-aligned slot rather than separate blocks? Our ideal window is something that maps to late morning SG / early evening AUS — roughly 02:00–04:00 UTC. We know this is a compressed ask and want to check availability across your SI host and marketplace ops folks.

I've attached the draft attendee roster and customer priorities (nodewave-demo-reqs.xlsx). Happy to be flexible on presenters — primary ask is a shorter, high-impact run-through.

Cheers,
Sam
Partnerships Manager, NodeWave

---
Attachments: nodewave-demo-reqs.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — APAC co-sell demo (compact window request)

Sam — thanks for the notes and the roster. Happy to support the compact approach; short answer: yes, we can do a consolidated 90-minute slot with one rehearsal.

Couple of operational asks before I lock calendar invites:
- Vanessa, can your SI partner handoff cover the first 20 minutes of technical preface and the final Q&A? If yes, we'll fold that into the run order.
- Karthik, I sketched three UTC slices that preserve the APAC overlap and allow a brief dry run right before the customer session. See attached (proposed-utc-slices.pdf).

If Vanessa confirms, I'll propose a single calendar window and ship the rehearsal runbook (short) and a one-page run order.

I also cc'd Jordan for marketplace ops awareness in case we need to toggle marketplace listing links during the demo.

Thanks —
Irene
Head of Field Co-sell, Redwood Inference

> Vanessa, can your SI partner handoff cover the first 20 minutes of technical preface and the final Q&A? If yes, we'll fold that into the run order.

Yes — I can cover the handoff. I spoke to our lead SI contact and they can handle a 20-min technical deep-dive and own Q&A for technical blockers. We should lock the facilitator to avoid overlap. Jordan, can you reserve the marketplace toggles and the publishing link?

Operational notes:
- Please plan a 15-minute focused dry run at M-30 to validate network/routes and marketplace preview link.
- Karthik: we have a competing GCP partner (Priya) who asked to validate a short integration snippet; can we fold that into minute 45–60?

Irene: propose we offer two concrete UTC options to Sam (see below) so NodeWave picks one. If neither works, we'll pivot to two adjacent slots.
Options (UTC, consolidated 90m):
A) 01:30–03:00 UTC — best for SG / Sydney crossover (earlier for AUS)
B) 02:00–03:30 UTC — slightly later, better for late-morning SG attendees

Vanessa

Priya — if we take option B (02:00–03:30 UTC), will you be able to present the integration clip live and stay for Q&A? We're aiming to keep the total heavy-demos portion to ~60 minutes and leave 20 for Q&A.

Operationally, we also propose the following condensed run order so we don't overshoot 90 minutes:
- 0:00–0:20: SI technical preface (Vanessa + SI)
- 0:20–0:50: Joint product walkthrough (Redwood + NodeWave)
- 0:50–1:00: Integration snippet (GCP partner)
- 1:00–1:15: Customer scenarios and live questions
- 1:15–1:30: Open Q&A / close

We'll prepare a one-page runbook (runbook-dryrun-agenda.pdf) and do the M-30 dry run. Sam — please confirm attendee clock constraints; if Option B is good we'll proceed to calendar + rehearsal link.

Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
